name: I run a landscaping company with two crews on the South Shore
needs: between May and September we miss a lot of calls because everyone is out on job sites
people leave a voicemail, and by the time we call back at night, they have hired someone else
I lose ten jobs a month that way in the summer
I write quotes on paper in the truck, sometimes they get lost before they get to the client, or my wife cannot read my handwriting
winter is quiet, but the phone is not a problem then
goals: if every caller heard back within an hour, I think most of them would book with us
stop writing quotes on paper by next spring
